question: Should this preflight decision become an OpenClaw core contract now, or remain inside the Claws package-lifecycle owner until another consumer or missing plugin API proves a shared seam is needed?
rationale: The PR introduces an otherwise unused core helper specifically for a later plugin-owned lifecycle change, and repository policy requires explicit ownership rather than speculative shared abstractions.

options.title: Keep It Owner-Local
options.body: Implement and prove the decision inside the Claws lifecycle owner, then propose a generic OpenClaw seam only if another consumer or concrete plugin API gap emerges.

options.title: Sponsor a Core Contract
options.body: Keep the helper in core, but first define its supported callers, fail-closed incomplete-record semantics, public boundary, and integration validation.

recommendation.title: Keep It Owner-Local
recommendation.body: Implement and prove the decision inside the Claws lifecycle owner, then propose a generic OpenClaw seam only if another consumer or concrete plugin API gap emerges.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest recent history for plugin installation, updates, persisted metadata, and compatibility behavior points here.
